competitiveTarget: Beat portal city-directory pages with a live regional pulse and a ledger of Central Oregon cities, not a link farm.
note: PUBLIC_UI.md §3 city grain (2026-08-14). First screen is doors to cities: name, median, months of supply, count. Not a city essay, not a number hero, not a house-stamp dump. Section order: Breadcrumb, Ledger (cities), Instrument (region pulse below the fold), Sheet (SFR alerts), Quiet (edges), Footer outside main. Chrome is layout-owned V3Chrome. Do not remount it. Capture: submitSearchAlertSignup with city empty and propertyType A, via RegionalAlertSheet (trap name company).
